children: Fifth Third Bancorp is boosting its quarterly dividend by 5% to 42 cents a share, up from 40 cents.
The new payout, equal to $1.68 a year, represents a 3.2% annual yield based on the company's Wednesday closing price of $52.41.
The dividend is payable on Oct. 15 to shareholders of record as of Sept. 30.
